name: zfmv_action_blur_begin
description: zFMV_ActionBlur::Begin snapshots SW and primary surface rectangles, configures the FX surface state for the active renderer path, and primes the work surface with the appropriate direct blit.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV Blur/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463870 validates the thiscall Begin contract: zero both rectangle origins, capture SW dimensions into swSurfaceRect, capture primary dimensions into primarySurfaceRect, configure FX state from SW pixels/pitch in software mode, configure FX state from primary pixels/pitch but SW dimensions in hardware mode, and dispatch the direct primary-to-SW or SW-to-primary blit with ECX=primarySurfaceRect and EDX=swSurfaceRect.
The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zVideo surface getters, Fx_SetSurfaceState, and direct blit dispatch providers are source-ready for the functional-verification mode.
The native smoke verifies both renderer paths, rectangle fields, FX surface-state fields, and direct blit callback argument order.
